## Snackbar (Snackbar / Toast)
Confirms an action. Made by shared.js, never written in the page:
```js
rpSnackbar('User deleted');                       // confirmation (default)
rpSnackbar('Failed to save changes', 'error');    // confirmation · info · warning · error
rpSnackbar('Review archived', 'confirmation', { action: 'Undo', onAction: function () { … } });
```
Or declarative: `<button … data-rp-snackbar="Report scheduled" data-rp-snackbar-variant="info">`. Bottom left by default (`position="left"`), 5 seconds, newest at the bottom.

Copy: the object and a past participle, sentence case, no period ("Alert created", "Changes saved"). Errors: "Failed to {verb} {object}". Never "successfully".

## Tooltip
```html
<button type="button" class="rp-icon-button" aria-label="Edit signature" data-rp-tooltip="Edit signature"><span class="rp-icon rp-icon-edit"></span></button>
<button … data-rp-tooltip="Settings" data-rp-tooltip-placement="right">
```
Placement: top (default), right, bottom, left. Tooltips name icon-only controls or explain a number; they never hold information the user needs to finish the task. They show on hover and on keyboard focus, stay while the focus scrolls the page, and Escape closes them (WCAG 1.4.13). The icon-only control still needs its own `aria-label`.
